description.value: The Campbell River branch of the Vancouver Island Regional Library serves the second-largest population in the VIRL system, situated in the heart of downtown on Shoppers Row on the unceded traditional territory of the Ligwiłda'xw people. The branch offers bookable meeting rooms, digital learning resources, and a broad range of community programs spanning literacy, technology, and local culture. It is a well-established civic anchor for a community described as poised for significant growth.
